scope: Independent cold-read and bounded source/scope review before publication. Actual public-page text, metadata, stylesheet, builder/validator changes, approved PNG/SVG and local gate evidence inspected. This does not certify browser layout, live publication, remote readiness, booking completion, payment/provider readiness or commercial effectiveness.
reader_takeaway: ConsoliData offers one continuous service that improves and connects marketing, sales, onboarding/training, everyday support and continued purchasing, then uses actual work and final business results to improve the next interaction.

customer_problem_first.evidence: The opening names repeated unanswered questions caused by customer knowledge staying in separate sales/support conversations and documents. The concrete service follows, before the single discussion action.

customer_problem_to_service_to_action.evidence: Home and services explain the customer task, connected work, concrete deliverables and a consistent Discuss your customer journey action to book.html. A recent task starts the service without shrinking the main offer to one report, list or piece of content.

findings: Primary service is full-journey connected continuous improvement; content/list research are components, not separate conflicting primary offers.

Useful content identifies relevant people through real questions and requests, followed by actual work, corrections and costs. It is not framed as community membership, agreement or automatically identifying anonymous readers.
Evaluation/purchasing, approved onboarding/training, everyday support, repeat use/purchasing and company knowledge all remain present.

Comparison and observation period are agreed; one factor changes; paid purchases, continued purchasing and contribution after costs are final outcomes. Questions and observations explain the process rather than substitute for the business result.
Company-wide copy fits actual purchasing/use paths and does not assume all readers are doctors or introduce a broad new outreach program.
No invented customer success, conversion percentage, guaranteed profit/share/sales, autonomous deployed platform or new marketing-subscription claim.
Artificial intelligence is described as helping research, analysis and preparation; the client reviews product-specific information and agrees changes.
Funnel is readable in the actual PNG inspected by reviewer, has no obvious cropping/overlap, preserves the customer journey and labels its widths as conceptual rather than measured conversion.
Approved own PNG/SVG files are exact hashes in the source-scope check; the graphical feedback loop includes listening, final results, retained learning and one-factor improvement.
Short concrete examples include a customer objection, training handoff, recurring support issue, source-linked buying evidence and checked answers.
Headers and paragraphs stay on the connected-service thesis; entry through real work and final discussion action are understandable.
No sender-centered testing/pilot opener, not-X-but-Y framing or unexplained sales/technical abbreviation found in the changed public copy.

First enterprise validation retains no prepaid service fee, written scope/input/time/evidence/acceptance/fee/payment-date requirements, payment after acceptance and no service fee for a valid validation that misses its standard.
Continued work has defined monitoring/maintenance/improvement scope; extra work and third-party costs are separately agreed. No open-ended free operation or automatic advertising spend.
Existing99USD standalone assessment remains optional and separate. Public manifest adds primaryService plus assessmentScope while preserving price/question/delivery/processing fields.
Book page invitation broadens to the journey but keeps existing Cal destination and email links; source preservation is not a claim that the calendar is available or a meeting was booked.

Tracked public differences are index/services/book, llms, site-manifest and narrowly adjusted source validator. Untracked public additions are exactly the dedicated stylesheet and two approved funnel assets.

No tracked backend/deploy/payment/report/deck source difference seen. Existing source-scope evidence reports73 protected public/backend/deploy files unchanged; this reviewer read the script and result rather than rerunning every protected byte comparison.
Cache validator permits only the new named stylesheet/version and changes the old homepage-positioning assertion; assessment/payment/privacy/bank/link checks remain intact.
No comment widget, new analytics, new collection backend, payment setting, appointment setting or unrelated site change introduced.

existing_failure_names: all six priced purchase entries open the existing payment form directly
legacy page offers a labelled real payment fallback without JavaScript
price-dependent scripts use the47USD release cache identity
discovery describes the direct destination and omits the obsolete interstitial
baseline_test_context.qualification: Saved baseline-node log covers19 tests; the after run covers28. The same four failing names target retired public direct-payment/price/cache contracts. These tests remain visible and were not fixed or suppressed in this content task. No claim that all tests pass.

required_recheck: If any pinned public text, asset, stylesheet, builder or validator changes, recheck the changed portion and update pins.
Integrator must separately finish real-browser desktop/mobile checks and actual deployment/readback gates before reporting live completion.

brief_review_snapshot.purpose: Historical review brief only; later mechanical status/commit updates do not change this content verdict.
